recentItems.title: Strong Man Badal (2026) | South Hindi Dubbed Movie | Prabhas, Aarthi Agarwal | Action Romantic Movie
recentItems.description:
Watch Strong Man Baadal, a powerful South Indian action-romantic drama starring Prabhas and Aarthi Agarwal, presented in Hindi dubbed version from the Telugu movie Adavi Ramudu.

Synopsis
The Childhood Bond: Ramu (Prabhas) is a poor orphan boy raised in a small tribal village surrounded by forest. During his childhood, he meets Madhu (Aarthi Agarwal), the daughter of a visiting politician. When Madhu's wealthy uncle severely insults Ramu for being an uneducated tribal kid, Madhu stands up for him and explicitly encourages Ramu to leave the jungle, go to the city, and get a higher education so the world will respect him.
The Reunion: Ten years later, Ramu successfully enters an urban college. He meets the college's most popular student, who turns out to be Madhu. The two fall deeply in love. At her grand birthday party, Madhu publicly reveals that Ramu is the same tribal boy from her childhood.
The Rebellion: This revelation outrages Madhu's mother, Tribhuvna (Telangana Shakuntala), a volatile and highly powerful woman with deep mafia and political connections. She violently throws Ramu out of the mansion and arranges Madhu's marriage to her cousin. To protect their love, Ramu and Madhu flee the city and seek refuge in the deep forest. The second half becomes a survival battle as the lovers are hunted down by Tribhuvna’s armed henchmen, with Ramu using his tactical knowledge of the jungle terrain to defeat the villains.

Watch Seetharama Kalyana (2026) – Full South Indian Hindi Dubbed Movie, starring Nikhil Kumar, Rachita Ram, Sanjay Kapoor, Bhagyashree, R. Sarathkumar and P. Ravishankar.

Synopsis
The Protagonists: Arya (Nikhil Kumaraswamy) is a good-hearted, happy-go-lucky youth and the son of an influential construction businessman named Shankar (R. Sarathkumar). Geetha (Rachita Ram) is a simple, traditional village girl who loves her family and believes strongly in God.
How They Meet: The two cross paths and fall in love during a wedding in Ooty, though they initially keep their feelings hidden from each other.
Conflicts and Twists: Geetha’s strict father is Narasimha (P. Ravishankar), and her mother is Madhoo (Lakshmi). When Geetha goes to Bengaluru for studies, Arya helps her navigate the city, and tensions eventually rise after an argument leads Geetha to accept another marriage proposal out of anger.
Family Background & Climax: A deeper historical connection and rivalry emerge involving Arya's biological parents (Sanjay Kapoor and Bhagyashree) and Narasimha's family. Through action-packed confrontations and emotional resolutions, Arya wins over Geetha and bridges the divide between the two families so that he and Geetha can finally unite.

Synopsis
Vijayaraghavan (played by Vijay Antony), a dedicated and righteous youth, moves from his village to a Chennai housing board colony. His primary goal is to fulfill his mother’s dream of clearing the civil services and becoming an IAS officer.
The Conflict: While living in the locality, he works to reform the local youth and unintentionally locks horns with Petha Perumal (Garuda Ram), a ruthless local councillor, and other corrupt political forces.
The Turn: Rather than backing down from their intimidation, Vijayaraghavan decides to fight the system from within. He steps into local politics, wins the councillor election himself, cleans up the neighborhood, and challenges the broader corrupt nexus.
The Climax: The narrative escalates into a power struggle against higher-ups and corrupt politicians like Minister Sethu (Sachin Khedekar), ending with Vijayaraghavan setting his sights on running for MLA to enact systemic change.
